description: CDISC SDTM/CDASH ETHNIC (C66790). Official codelist has only 2 values and is marked NON-extensible, unlike the CM-domain lists used elsewhere in this project (route, frequency, dose unit). A third value (unknown) is included here by explicit decision, not because the standard permits it -- Precision's ETHNIC field already collects it and losing it was judged worse than strict compliance. See is_extension flag: true on unknown means 'not part of the official codelist and the codelist does not formally allow extensions', which is a stronger caveat than the same flag elsewhere in this project.
source: NCI EVS CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology, ETHNIC C66790 (codelist_extensible: No, confirmed across multiple dated snapshots 2013-2022); unknown value added by explicit decision 2026-09-28, not by CDISC allowance
